_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV decroissante. Production volume = signal upstream, realized crude price = exposition cycle commodities, sales revenue, operating cash flow = capital return capacity. Production en tete car growth path Marathon acquisition + Permian.

kpis.signal: Croissance soutenue 12% CAGR, boost Marathon Oil acquisition Q4 2024 + Surmont working interest
kpis.description_fr: Production totale en milliers de barils equivalent petrole par jour (Crude + NGL + Gaz + Bitumen). KPI #1 upstream pure-play.
kpis.description_en: Total production in thousand barrels of oil equivalent per day (Crude + NGL + Gas + Bitumen). #1 upstream pure-play KPI.

kpis.signal: Stabilisation autour 77 $/bbl en 2024, exposition directe Brent/WTI, leverage majeur sur cash flow
kpis.description_fr: Prix moyen realise petrole brut total (consolidated + equity affiliates). Driver #1 du cash flow et capital return.
kpis.description_en: Average realized crude oil price total (consolidated + equity affiliates). #1 cash flow and capital return driver.

kpis.signal: Stabilise apres pic FY22, finance capital return program (~60% du CFO distribue aux actionnaires)
kpis.description_fr: Cash genere par les operations. Determine la capacite de capital return (dividende + buybacks + variable distribution). Politique ~50%+ CFO aux actionnaires.
kpis.description_en: Cash from operations. Drives capital return capacity (dividend + buybacks + variable distribution). Policy: ~50%+ CFO to shareholders.

kpis.signal: Recul FY24 sur prix gaz/petrole compenses partiellement par volumes Marathon + Surmont
kpis.description_fr: CA des ventes crude + NGL + gaz + bitumen + trading. Tres sensible cycle commodities, less so than peers diversified.
kpis.description_en: Revenue from crude + NGL + gas + bitumen + trading. Very commodity-cycle sensitive, less so than diversified peers.

kpis.signal: Segment hero (~58% prod), boost Concho 2021 + Marathon 2024 + Permian/Eagle Ford/Bakken
kpis.description_fr: Production segment Lower 48 (Permian, Eagle Ford, Bakken). Hero post acquisitions Concho (2021), Shell Permian (2021), Marathon Oil (Q4 2024).
kpis.description_en: Lower 48 segment production (Permian, Eagle Ford, Bakken). Post-acquisitions hero: Concho (2021), Shell Permian (2021), Marathon Oil (Q4 2024).
